# Cairn Documentation — LLM-Friendly Index

This file provides a machine-readable index of all documentation pages for LLM context ingestion.

## File Index

- `docs/index.md` — What Cairn is, how to start, where to find things
- `docs/getting-started/installation.md` — Install on a server (and local development at the end)
- `docs/getting-started/project-structure.md` — Monorepo directory map
- `docs/getting-started/first-project.md` — Create a project, get an SDK token
- `docs/getting-started/node-sdk-quickstart.md` — Node.js SDK quickstart
- `docs/getting-started/react-sdk-quickstart.md` — React SDK quickstart
- `docs/getting-started/angular-sdk-quickstart.md` — Angular SDK quickstart

- `docs/getting-started/upgrade-guide.md` — Move an app from Caps to Cairn: SDK packages, settings and code changes
- `docs/guides/databases.md` — Add a database to your app: PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Redis per environment; where credentials live
- `docs/operations/recover.md` — Fix a broken install: status, recover, repair, mfa disable, restore
- `docs/guides/authentication.md` — Control who can sign in: roles, permissions, built-in OIDC/SSO for bundled tools
- `docs/guides/mfa.md` — Two-factor sign-in: TOTP, recovery codes, step-up, required roles, break-glass
- `docs/guides/secrets-management.md` — Store secrets and settings for your app: Configuration > Variables, encryption, history, SDK config
- `docs/guides/preview-environments.md` — Preview environment pipeline
- `docs/guides/monitoring.md` — See what your apps are doing: project Monitoring views, fleet Monitoring, Grafana
- `docs/guides/observability.md` — Search logs, traces and metrics: Monitoring views (Overview, Logs, Traces, Users, Resources), limits, API
- `docs/guides/frontend-rum.md` — Monitor real users in the browser: React/Angular SDK web vitals, errors, routes, session replay, privacy
- `docs/guides/status-pages.md` — Publish a public status page: components from uptime checks, incidents, maintenance, feeds
- `docs/guides/heatmaps.md` — See where visitors click and scroll: heatmaps in Monitoring > Users
- `docs/observability/error-tracking.md` — Track and fix errors: grouping, assign/resolve, source maps, alerts
- `docs/operations/alerting.md` — Get alerts when something breaks: channels, monitors, SLOs, silences, on-call
- `docs/operations/synthetics.md` — Check that your site is up: HTTP, multistep and browser uptime checks
- `docs/observability/releases.md` — Compare releases and roll back: release markers, before/after comparison
- `docs/operations/telemetry.md` — Turn on full monitoring: the full install profile for traces, logs and profiles
- `docs/operations/telemetry-privacy.md` — Privacy and data retention: scrubbing, consent, retention, GDPR delete
- `docs/operations/database-monitoring.md` — See slow queries and database health per project
- `docs/operations/storage-providers.md` — Store files in S3, R2 or another bucket: Settings > Storage
- `docs/operations/backups.md` — Back up and restore your server: platformctl backup, schedule, restore, restore tests
- `docs/operations/ha.md` — Run Cairn on several servers: ha profile, join, failover, datastores
- `docs/guides/host-hardening.md` — Secure the server: firewall, SSH, ingress defaults, optional WAF
- `docs/guides/namespace-isolation.md` — How projects are kept apart: namespaces, network policies, quotas
- `docs/operations/image-signing.md` — Check that Cairn images are genuine: scanning, signing, admission
- `docs/mcp/overview.md` — Let an AI assistant work with your server: MCP overview
- `docs/mcp/setup.md` — Connect Cursor or Claude to Cairn: agent tokens, MCP server setup
- `docs/mcp/tools.md` — What an AI assistant can do: MCP tools, scopes, command policy and approvals
- `docs/mcp/for-agents.md` — Rules for AI agents: protocol for agents using the Cairn MCP server
- `docs/operations/upgrades.md` — Upgrade Cairn to a new release: platformctl upgrade, auto-upgrade, rollback
